## Foods & dishes
- [[ArabCulture]]: 279 items, 58 food (13 Syria-specific) + 8 food-adjacent.
- [[WorldCuisines]]: 38 dishes, 1 Syria-specific. [[FmLAMA]]: 5 dishes (106 rows). [[World Wide Dishes]]: 5 dishes, none Syria-only.
- [[ArSyra Food and Culture]]: the 50 preview records we hold are Syrian (Levantine dialect); the full commercial product claims 4,579 records across 15 countries.
- No recipe corpus has a Syria label.

## Ingredients & food composition
- No Syrian FCT. Levantine proxies: [[Lebanon traditional dishes composition]] (candidate), borrowed Lebanese/Jordanian rows in [[Bahrain Food Composition Tables]]. Candidate: [[EMFID (Eastern Mediterranean Food Information Data Bank)|EMFID]].

## Compounds & traditional medicine
- [[KNApSAcK Family]]: 163 records (137 edible / 26 medicinal). [[Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases|Duke]]: 10 records. [[CMAUP]]: only 6 plants (5 scraped).
- Compounds and health effects come only from the [[Global]] resources ([[FooDB]], [[CTD]], [[NPASS]], [[SpiceRx]]).
